# `avg`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the mean calculated from values of a group.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
avg(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- avg, example 1
> SELECT avg(col) FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3) AS tab(col);
2.0
```

```sql
-- avg, example 2
> SELECT avg(col) FROM VALUES (1), (2), (NULL) AS tab(col);
1.5
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
